min_standing_note.value: Requires nomination by a home partner university; undergraduate exchange students select 30xxx undergraduate-level courses.
min_standing_note.notes: No central incoming GPA minimum published; academic selection is handled by the home partner university.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel agreement scope is 'Business and Economics'; at AUC, Business and the Mohamed Shafik Gabr Department of Economics are both housed in the Onsi Sawiris School of Business (BUS) per https://www.aucegypt.edu/academics/school-business.

english_course_availability.notes: Wide array of undergraduate and graduate courses taught in English alongside Italian offerings in the official exchange course table.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 level in English (or Italian for Italian-taught courses) expected and verified through home-university nomination; no central TOEFL/IELTS test score mandate published on the incoming exchange portal. RHET 1020 exemption not stated.

host_language_requirement.value: Not required for English-taught courses; B2 Italian expected if selecting Italian-taught courses. Optional pre-term Italian crash course offered (Aug 25–Sep 5 Fall; Jan 25–Feb 6 Spring).
host_language_requirement.notes: Crash course dates for AY 2026-2027 published on https://www.unibocconi.it/en/for-international-students/incoming-exchange-students.

fall_term_dates.notes: AY 2026-2027 Fall schedule: mandatory check-in Aug 25–28; Italian crash course Aug 25–Sep 5; classes Sep 2–Dec 5; mid-terms Oct 19–28; early exchange exam session Dec 9–22 (earliest departure Dec 23); regular exam sessions Jan 7–19 and Jan 20–Feb 2, 2027.

spring_term_dates.notes: AY 2026-2027 Spring schedule (TBC welcome): check-in Jan 25–29; crash course Jan 25–Feb 6; classes Feb 3–May 15 (some Law courses end May 22); mid-terms Mar 18–Apr 3; 1st exam session May 17–31; 2nd exam session Jun 3–Jul 10.

tuition_model.notes: Incoming bilateral exchange students pay tuition at their home institution and are exempt from Bocconi tuition and academic fees.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: AY 2026-2027 Cost of Attendance monthly living budget estimate (EUR 1,700–1,800/month, contextually used e.g. for US Direct Loans planning). Incoming-exchange specific page (https://www.unibocconi.it/en/foe/incoming-exchange-students/estimated-costs) and AY25-26 factsheet (data/raw/factsheets/Bocconi/2025-2026/AY2526_Factsheet International Student Desk Exchange_Pieghevole.pdf#page=2) itemize private double room EUR 500–750/mo, single room EUR 600–1,100/mo, flat EUR 800–1,800/mo, dorm EUR 4,000–4,800/sem, canteen ~EUR 5/meal, metro pass EUR 22/mo (<27 yrs).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month midpoint estimate: 1,750 EUR/month * 5 months = 8,750 EUR * 1.1052 USD/EUR = 9,670.50 USD (ECB 2026-11-13 reference rate, collected 2026-11-15: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: No mandatory Bocconi enrollment health insurance fee; non-EU students require valid international health insurance for visa/Permesso di Soggiorno (e.g., WAI Italy ~EUR 91/6 months) and pay ~EUR 100.46 + EUR 16 stamp for Permesso di Soggiorno.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Confirmed also in data/raw/factsheets/Bocconi/2025-2026/AY2526_Factsheet International Student Desk Exchange_Pieghevole.pdf#page=2.

housing_notes.value: Limited on-campus residence rooms (EUR 4,000–4,800/semester single) allocated on a first-come, first-served basis; Bocconi provides guidance for private rentals (double EUR 500–750/mo, single EUR 600–1,100/mo, entire flat EUR 800–1,800/mo).
housing_notes.notes: Rent itemization from https://www.unibocconi.it/en/foe/incoming-exchange-students/estimated-costs and AY25-26 factsheet #page=2.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU incoming exchange students require an Italian Type D Student Visa prior to arrival via Universitaly / local Italian Consulate and must apply for a Permesso di Soggiorno within 8 working days of arrival (~EUR 100.46 + EUR 16 revenue stamp).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Visa portal URL extracted from Bocconi fact sheet; Permesso fees from https://www.unibocconi.it/en/foe/incoming-exchange-students/estimated-costs.

english_course_list_url.notes: Course table at https://didattica.unibocconi.eu/ts/tsn_ord_ir.php requires interactive language/level filtering rather than a static English-only URL.

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS equivalent (1 Bocconi credit = ~25h total workload including ~8 lecture hours); incoming exchange students take 1 to 5 courses per semester.

course_restrictions_note.value: Undergraduate exchange students must select undergraduate-level courses (coded in the 30xxx series); graduate and integrated Law offerings are restricted to matching degree levels.

value: Passport personal data page (or EU national ID card)
Disability certificate from home university (optional, only if requesting accommodations)

academic_style.value: Lecture and written/oral exam assessment with mid-term sessions and an early December exam session option for Fall exchange students.

campus_type.notes: Urban city campus located in Milan.

international_support_services.value: International Student Desk (ISD) online application portal, mandatory Welcome Check-in days, optional pre-term Italian crash course, visa/Permesso guidance, and housing info.

nomination_deadlines.value: Home partner coordinator submits online nomination first; Spring 2027 student online application window ran Sep 30 – Oct 22, 2026 (15:00 CET). Fall deadlines communicated per partner nomination cycle.
